September 8, 2026—KB5999008 (OS Builds 26200.9445 and 26100.9445)

Summary

This security update includes quality improvements.

Known issues in this update

Applies toSymptomWorkaround
All usersRemote Desktop Services might become unstable

After installing this update, Remote Desktop Services (RDS) might become unstable and RDP connections might fail after several minutes.

This issue is mitigated using a Known Issue Rollback (KIR). Install and configure the special Group Policy.
IT adminsCredential Guard machine accounts might lose secure channel

Users might be unable to sign in interactively with valid domain credentials.

We are working on a resolution.

How to get this update

Windows Update, WSUS, Microsoft Update Catalog.
